SELECT ni.published_at, ni.created_at, v.effect_level AS wirkung_staerke, v.relevance AS relevant
FROM trading.v_news_latest_assessment v JOIN trading.news_items ni ON ni.id = v.news_id;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (workflow_name) workflow_name, finished_at
FROM trading.pipeline_runs WHERE status = 'success' ORDER BY workflow_name, finished_at DESC;

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (agent_name) agent_name, model_name, prompt_version, status, started_at, confidence
FROM trading.agent_runs ORDER BY agent_name, started_at DESC;
SELECT status, count(*) AS anzahl FROM trading.news_items GROUP BY status;

SELECT status, count(*) AS anzahl,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE confounded) AS confounded_anzahl,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction_correct = TRUE) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction_correct IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS trefferquote
FROM trading.news_impact_tracking GROUP BY status;

SELECT count(*) AS offene_vorschlaege, max(created_at) AS letzter_vorschlag_am
FROM trading.learning_rule_proposals WHERE status = 'proposed';

SELECT source AS value, count(*) AS sample_size,
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction_correct = TRUE) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction_correct IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS trefferquote
FROM trading.news_impact_tracking
WHERE status = 'completed' AND confounded = FALSE AND source IS NOT NULL
  AND created_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY source ORDER BY sample_size DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT config_key, value_bool, value_text, value_numeric, description, updated_at FROM trading.pipeline_config ORDER BY config_key;
SELECT ticker, snapshot_date, kgv, kursziel, empfehlung FROM trading.fundamentals_history WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 5 AND valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY ticker, snapshot_date;
SELECT symbol, snapshot_date, aktueller_kurs, veraenderung_pct, trend, markt_status FROM trading.market_context_history WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 5 ORDER BY symbol, snapshot_date;
SELECT ticker, snapshot_date, aktueller_kurs, rsi, richtung, handels_status FROM trading.technical_signals_history WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 5 ORDER BY ticker, snapshot_date;
SELECT ticker, action, blockers_json, created_at FROM trading.recommendation_veto_log WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY created_at DESC;
SELECT ticker, market_code, session_status, letztes_verfuegbares_handelsdatum FROM trading.v_market_session_status ORDER BY ticker;
SELECT ticker, strategy, direction, raw_score, regime_fit FROM trading.strategy_signals WHERE business_date = CURRENT_DATE AND valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY strategy, raw_score DESC;
SELECT region, trend_regime, volatility_regime, stress_regime, combined_regime, regime_confidence, session_status FROM trading.market_regime WHERE business_date = CURRENT_DATE;

SELECT sc.ticker, sc.stage, sc.included, sc.reason, sc.scan_score, sc.strategy_hint FROM trading.scan_candidates sc JOIN (SELECT run_id FROM trading.scan_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON sc.run_id = latest.run_id ORDER BY sc.stage, sc.included DESC, sc.scan_score DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT trade_id, ticker, strategy, direction, simulated_entry_price, stop_price_current, target_price_initial, realized_r_multiple, maximum_favorable_excursion, maximum_adverse_excursion, time_stop_at, risk_amount, status FROM trading.paper_trades WHERE status IN ('open','proposed') ORDER BY created_at DESC;
SELECT trade_id, ticker, strategy, net_pnl, realized_r_multiple, exit_reason, holding_period_days FROM trading.paper_trades WHERE status = 'closed' ORDER BY exit_time DESC LIMIT 30;

SELECT strategy, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed') AS n, round(avg(realized_r_multiple) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed')::numeric, 3) AS expectancy_r, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed' AND net_pnl > 0) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed'), 0), 1) AS win_rate_pct, round(sum(net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed' AND net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(ABS(sum(net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed' AND net_pnl < 0)), 0), 3) AS profit_factor FROM trading.paper_trades GROUP BY strategy;
SELECT ticker, portfolio_approved, portfolio_risk_before, portfolio_risk_after, blockers_json, checked_at FROM trading.portfolio_risk_checks ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT scenario_name, estimated_loss, loss_pct_of_portfolio, data_quality FROM trading.stress_scenarios WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM trading.stress_scenarios ORDER BY computed_at DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT proposal_type, target_type, target_value, status, sample_size, metric_value, created_at FROM trading.learning_rule_proposals ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;
